end.parentNote: Asha practised classifying what animals eat and building food chains with arrows. Manav used examples such as grass → insect and algae → larvae → fish, and correctly discussed what may happen when part of a chain is removed. They mixed up whether grass eats something; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask them to sort three animals into plant-eater, meat-eater, or both, then make one chain for each.
